title: zega graph-component contract (APS 21)
description: What a graph component accepts: data roles (typed, with units), surface parameters and display options (each a JSON Schema with a default). Agents and the /components gallery read this file; the runtime validates view specs against it.

version.description: Semver. A major bump means old view specs no longer bind.

surface.description: The surface this component draws on, e.g. "map".

example.description: A worked example: the ZQL, and the view spec that binds its result.

type.description: lonlat[]: ordered [lon, lat] pairs, or ZQL Point values ({lat, lon}). f64[]: finite numbers. string: text.

ordered.description: The role's list order is meaningful (a path's points in sequence). Bind it from an `order by` selection.

sameLengthAs.description: Another role whose list this one must match in length, item for item.

setting.description: A JSON Schema for one parameter or option, plus its `default`.
